assets.name: card-paper
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game texture atlas, six blank handmade paper card faces. Input image is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match the tactile folded colored paper and warm ivory inset of the cards at bottom. Generate a clean exact 3 columns by 2 rows atlas, equal cells, 1536 by 1360 canvas. Each cell is a portrait 3:4 card, orthographic top down, straight rectangular edges with small angular clipped corners, no perspective, no rotation. Cards almost fill each cell, consistent 3% outer padding. Row 1 left to right: rose pink frame, leaf green frame, apricot orange frame. Row 2 left to right: lavender purple frame, warm golden yellow frame, soft turquoise teal frame. Every card is BLANK: a broad warm ivory paper center covering 82 percent of face with hand-torn angular paper edges, colored folded cardstock border, visible tiny natural fibers and pressed wrinkles, subtle folds at corner tabs, softly lit dimensional handmade diorama material. Keep center light and suitable for dark dynamic game text and separate artwork overlay. The ivory inset should be empty with rich but restrained paper grain. No objects, animals, icons, letters, symbols, numbers, illustration, watermark, labels, grids, divider lines, environment, box or scene. All six shapes perfectly aligned, equally sized and isolated from each other. Outside the card outlines and in small gutters use a perfectly uniform solid pure blue #0000ff chroma-key background, no shadows or gradients on the key; do not use that blue in the cards.

assets.name: hud-tab
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: game HUD blank paper badge. Input is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, copy the small cream cut-paper plaques behind the balloon counts and heart count at the top. Generate ONE blank warm ivory handmade cardstock plaque isolated on a perfectly uniform flat pure blue #0000ff chroma-key background. Wide horizontal rectangular paper tab, aspect 2:1, straight edges with small irregular clipped angular corners. Orthographic front view, no rotation or perspective. The plaque fills 94% of canvas width and 88% of height with consistent margin, full silhouette visible. Detailed natural paper fibers, crumpled fine papergrain, a few subtle little fold creases along perimeter, warm cream center, a hint of layered cardboard thickness at lower edge. Match the cheerful richly detailed papercraft game reference. Empty center for dynamic number and icon overlays. NO text, letters, numbers, symbols, icon, animal, balloon, heart, coin or illustration. No cast shadow or texture on blue background. No surrounding scene. Do not use blue anywhere in the plaque. Canvas landscape 2:1.
